_doc: Shrink film soundtrack (real-sound skill): real licensed recordings only, credited in CREDITS.md. Built by <skill>/scripts/mix.py from this file and one fragment per category in audio/design/. Music first; sfx/amb fragments get added to include.
_buses_doc: Music rides: flat groove 0-44.3; a 1.5 dB lift across the track's own loud run 44.3-51.5 (the build into the stop); the step to +3 dB happens inside the black-frame silence (51.7-51.95) so the drop at 52.0 is the loudest part of the film; back to 0 dB just before the final chord's downbeat at 57.54 (resolve on the end card).
_master_doc: -14 LUFS integrated for TikTok/Reels/Shorts; ceiling 0.77 linear leaves room for the AAC encode.
